newsitem.title: JAPAN: Dlr seen range-bound in Asia, focus on meetings.
newsitem.headline: Dlr seen range-bound in Asia, focus on meetings.

text.p: The dollar is expected to be range-bound against the yen in Asia on Friday as the market awaits a U.S-Japan bilateral meeting later in the day and a meeting of Group of Seven (G7) officials on Sunday, dealers said.
Bids from importers and investors are expected near 125.80 yen, while exporter offers are likely above 126.20 yen, keeping the day's trade mostly in a narrow range, they added.
News reports that Japan's Ministry of Finance (MOF) plans to issue an order to halt operations of Nissan Mutual Life Insurance Co may spark some dollar purchases, one dealer said.
